description: A React component for rendering and managing a post list in a chat channel, including loading posts, handling pagination, and performance telemetry.

classes.name: PostList
classes.description: A React component that displays a list of posts in a channel, manages loading states, pagination, and performance metrics.

methods.name: markAndMeasureChannelSwitchEnd
methods.description: Marks and measures the end of a channel or team switch for performance telemetry.

methods.name: postsOnLoad
methods.description: Handles post loading logic when the component mounts or the channel changes.

methods.name: callLoadPosts
methods.description: Calls the loadPosts action and handles retries on failure.

methods.name: getOldestVisiblePostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the oldest post currently visible.

methods.name: getLatestVisiblePostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the latest post currently visible.

methods.name: canLoadMorePosts
methods.description: Determines if more posts can be loaded, with auto-load logic.

methods.name: getPostsBefore
methods.description: Loads posts before the oldest visible post.

methods.name: getPostsAfter
methods.description: Loads posts after the latest visible post.

methods.name: getPostsBeforeAutoLoad
methods.description: Automatically loads posts before the oldest visible post for infinite scrolling.
